title: Add Agentic Automation to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Agentic Automation](https://pollinations-chat-kohl.vercel.app) to build
- Flow is a visual no-code agentic workflow builder powered by pollinations.ai. Chain together Trigger, AI Agent, HTTP Request, Transform, Condition, and Output nodes on a drag-and-drop canvas. Each AI

Fixes #10206

gist.headline: Flow finds its path
gist.blurb: A new no-code workflow garden has sprouted in build. Drag together triggers, agents, requests, and decisions; let the little processes wander off and do useful things.
gist.summary: Added Flow, a visual no-code agentic workflow builder powered by pollinations.ai, to build with drag-and-drop Trigger, AI Agent, HTTP Request, Transform, Condition, and Output nodes.
gist.impact: Builders can now compose multi-step AI automations visually instead of wiring each trigger, model call, request, and branch together by hand.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Flow as a cozy garden-like drag-and-drop workflow canvas: connected node tiles form a winding path from a trigger flower through an AI-agent terminal, HTTP watering can, transform plant, condition signpost, and output mailbox. Polli should wear a tiny builder tool belt and gently place a glowing node onto the path, with code-vines and small flowers showing that the automation is growing organically.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, arranging glowing drag-and-drop workflow nodes along a garden path: Trigger flower, AI Agent CRT terminal, HTTP watering can, Transform code-plant, Condition signpost, and Output mailbox. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, code-vines and flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
